ideas.pitch: An autonomous drone equipped with edge AI and obstacle avoidance designed to patrol and intercept unauthorized perimeter breaches in restricted zones.
ideas.title: AeroGuard: Autonomous Drone Intrusion Interceptor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Mechavers domain directly with a complete working physical flight prototype that performs edge-based computer vision tracking, moving beyond simulation.

ideas.pitch: A self-healing decentralized LoRa and ESP-NOW mesh transceiver device for instant off-grid first-responder communication during infrastructure blackouts.
ideas.problem_statement: Wavenex: Wireless Communication, RF & Signal Processing
ideas.title: MeshCom: Resilient LoRa Emergency Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates proven live-demonstration reliability from offline communication winners, allowing judges to test instant peer-to-peer packet routing without cellular towers.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight reconfigurable hardware accelerator deployed on an FPGA board to perform real-time AES encryption and side-channel attack mitigation for edge nodes.
ideas.title: EdgeShield: FPGA-Based Hardware Crypto Coprocessor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting Silicore with deep hardware engineering; judges in VLSI tracks value register-transfer level (RTL) implementations that run on physical development boards.

ideas.pitch: An edge AI embedded hardware box that runs quantized deep learning models on a local camera feed to instantly detect worker safety violations in factories.
ideas.problem_statement: Neuronix: Edge AI, Embedded Intelligence & Deep Tech
ideas.title: VisionEdge: Industrial PPE & Safety Violation Watchdog
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time embedded intelligence with a physical enclosure and live local alert triggers, demonstrating immediate industrial deployment utility.

ideas.pitch: An industrial IoT telemetry module combining thermal imaging and vibration sensors with an edge microcontroller to predict power grid transformer failures.
ideas.title: GridSentinel: Autonomous Substation Thermal and Vibration Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Nexusgrid infrastructure track by solving a massive economic problem for utilities with a tangible sensor rig that outputs live telemetry dashboards.
